text:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — NovaHealth returned the vendor risk form. Key asks: embeddings retention beyond 90 days, BYOK/KMS, and audit logs export. Renewal due in ~45 days, currently at renew-risk 0.65. Can we triage what evidence + controls we can offer?

Liam (Security): Thanks @Maya. Short version: BYOK for Hosted is possible but requires Private control-plane or Dedicated with KMS integration; needs legal + infra sign-off. For SOC2 evidence we can provide: SOC2 report, dataflow diagram, logging-config excerpt, and KMS attestation doc. For embeddings retention >90 days we'll need to confirm storage tier + retention policy — approvable if data classification is acceptable. I'll compile a checklist.

Ava (Onboarding): I can run an enablement call with NovaHealth next week. Suggested asks: signed DPA addendum with retention clause, KMS provider & contact, preferred retention window, and the vendor questionnaire filled into our template. I'll draft a short checklist and meeting deck.

ops-bot: /link https://internal.redwood.com/kb/soc2-evidence-runbook :memo: (runbook contains templates for dataflow diagrams, KMS attestation, and retention SLA language)

Maya (CSM): @Liam what specifically do you need from Nova to keep their risk < 0.7 (avoid escalation)? Need a concise list I can send to the customer.

Liam (Security): Minimal items to de-escalate: 1) Signed DPA addendum with BYOK clause OR confirmation they accept our standard KMS policy, 2) Dataflow diagram with PII labeling, 3) Evidence of key management (KMS attestation or rotation policy), 4) Retention SLA agreed in writing. If all provided, projected risk drops to ~0.45. If they insist on BYOK for Hosted, note it adds infra work & procurement lead time (~3 weeks).

Ava (Onboarding): I'll draft the checklist and a calendar invite. Availability: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. Maya, can you ask the customer to upload docs to the secure folder? Suggested presign command for them: 

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-secure/novahealth/ --expires-in 604800
```

Maya (CSM): Message to customer sent (DM + email). Putting follow-ups into Asana and tagging @Liam @Ava. Will update here once they respond. :thumbsup:

Liam (Security): Thanks. One extra note — for embeddings retention beyond our standard 90d we need to confirm retention encryption-at-rest and access controls in the storage backend. If they provide acceptance in writing, we can add a retention SLA clause and keep standard SLA.

Ava (Onboarding): Copy. I'll prep the deck with: agenda, evidence list, required signatures, and a short run-through of KMS options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). I'll also upload the checklist to the KB link.

Maya (CSM): Next actions recap: Maya -> request/upload link + nudge customer and schedule call; Ava -> create checklist + invite + meeting deck; Liam -> produce evidence pack (SOC2 + attestation) and BYOK feasibility note. Will update thread after call.

Maya (CSM): tagging this for priority: renewal in 45d — keeping it on my radar. :spiral_calendar:
